json.reason: The only evidence is that one question (Q18) was answered much faster than the cohort, but the rest of the survey was completed at a normal or even slower pace. One isolated fast click, especially on a simple single-choice question, does not substantiate bad faith.
json.panel_text: If there were a problem, it would be because the last question ('How likely are you to buy Kettlebird in the next month?') was answered much faster than most people. However, this question only asks for a quick choice, so answering quickly does not mean you did anything wrong.
